title: Proxy handshake SLA templates and risk thresholds for air-gapped connections
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Deliver a set of standardized 'proxy handshake' templates (SLA language + technical acceptance checks) and an operational risk-threshold rubric for customers with air-gapped or highly restricted egress. Goal: reduce manual triage time, give CS/SEs deterministic acceptance criteria, and enable automated preflight checks that signal 'go/no-go' for scheduled upgrade windows.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A living Confluence page with 3 SLA template variations (Fastlane, Standard, Conservative) and corresponding technical checks exists. 2) A lightweight 'handshake' probe script (shell + Go) that runs edge-to-control-plane checks and outputs a pass/fail + signal reasons is published in docs and as a GitHub gist. 3) SE/CS checklist and one-pager comm templates for each SLA tier created. 4) Risk-threshold rubric defined (numeric score) and integrated into intake scoring (manual for MVP). 5) Two pilot customers complete a simulated upgrade using the template and provide feedback.
tasks: Draft three SLA template variants and legal-friendly wording
Define technical acceptance checks (ports, TLS root, HA endpoints, latency thresholds, packet loss thresholds)
Create handshake probe script and include example outputs
Design a numeric risk-threshold rubric (0-100) mapping to intake lanes
Write CS/SE playbook & comm templates (email + runbook steps)
Pilot with two customers and iterate on templates
Instrument telemetry events (probe.pass/probe.fail/reasons) for future automation
notes_and_decisions: 2025-11-12: Decided to standardize on three SLA profiles to cover ~90% of incoming private requests; avoids one-off legal edits for MVP.
2025-11-28: Engineering recommends adding TLS root thumbprint validation to handshake probe rather than full cert chain verification to simplify customer integration.
2025-12-10: Legal reviewed SLA wording: moved indemnity language to appendix and introduced opt-in checkbox for non-standard windows.
2026-01-04: Scoped telemetry to 'probe.status' + 'probe.reason' only for MVP to avoid PII and reduce retention concerns.
2026-01-10: Pilot customers selected: Acme FinTech (high risk, conservative SLA) and ClearHealth (standard SLA). Security review scheduled for 2026-01-14.
comments: 2025-11-05 Sofia Patel: Raising this because CS time-to-triage for proxy/network questions is averaging 4 days. Templates + probe should reduce that to under 24 hours for qualified requests.
2025-11-18 Marco Ruiz: I'll pair with infra to produce the initial probe. Need eng bandwidth allocation for 2 weeks in Dec to review integration points.
2025-12-01 Legal team (Maya Liu): Provided redlines; removed absolute uptime commitments from Fastlane SLA; suggested escalation cadence inclusion.
2025-12-15 Engineering (Priya Shah): Probe PoC ready; flagged corner case where HTTPS interception appliances rewrite TLS SNI — added fallback heuristic.
2026-01-11 Customer Success (Daniel Kim): Pilots scheduled; Acme FinTech agreed to run probe in pre-prod window on 2026-01-20. Feedback will determine if risk thresholds need tightening.
